[center][s]"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22520](CP) Buildable Large Trees Pack[/url]﻿﻿" is required.
[/s][/center][/size][s]
The four regular tree types have the same open conditions as the ”[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22520](CP) Buildable Large Trees Pack[/url]”.

The liberation conditions for palm trees and mushroom trees are...

[spoiler]Desert Palm Trees: Bus repairs are complete.
Island Palm Trees: Willy's boat is repaired.
Mushroom trees: Have already watched the event where you enter Qi's Walnut Room and talk with Qi.
[/spoiler]
Normal trees are implemented as furniture in other mods, which are more convenient, but require "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿" to use, and using "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿" has the problem of long loading times, so I created this mod.
